scientificQuestions: Reconcile the same NCT's earlier Phase 2b portion with the separate pivotal Phase 3 cohort and exact registered versions before comparing results.
Verify the original NEJM 2025 and 2026 publisher versions, protocol/SAP changes, full trial tables, analyses and source provenance against authorized original bytes.
Treat week-36 UPCR as biomarker-driven primary interim measure and week-52/104 eGFR and progression as distinct later secondary outcomes.
Assess prespecified interim and final analysis testing hierarchy, alpha expenditure, missing data and multiplicity without retroactively inventing statistical approvals.
Review proteinuria as a surrogate versus clinical kidney-function and kidney-failure outcomes with a qualified nephrologist.
Reconcile 203 interim versus 431 randomized/428 treated final populations without pooling trial denominators or adverse-event rates.
Independently review serious adverse events, immunomodulator infection and immune effects, safety follow-up and populations excluded.
Record whether later 2026 evidence was available before the exact PDUFA prediction cutoff; exclude any later evidence from blind historical backtests.
Verify provisional FDA application-cycle mapping separately from trial identity and published outcomes.
Obtain separate authorized source authentication, statistical review, disease review, independent challenge and final adjudication.
